valuation.method: Forward Adjusted EPS x P/E (FY2027 combined-company adjusted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date, incorporating Q3 2026 results and the November 2, 2026 Kenvue acquisition close)

bear.driver: Deeper Kenvue integration dilution, China social media disruption, and North American volume softness

base.driver: Steady Kenvue integration with no more than mid-single-digit 2027 EPS dilution vs. 2026 standalone

bull.driver: Faster Kenvue cost/revenue synergy capture and organic sales growth recovery

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS of $7.00, the $109.43 close implies 15.6x forward P/E; at 16.5x P/E, the close implies $6.63 EPS.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $7.00 (6.4 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Combined-company organic sales growth and Kenvue integration synergy/amortization run-rate
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 / FY2026 earnings release (expected late January / early February 2027)

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 earnings (Nov 5, 2026) and the Nov 2, 2026 Kenvue acquisition close, UBS (Peter Grom) and Barclays (Lauren Lieberman) nudged targets up to $113 and $112 while staying Neutral/Equal-Weight, closely aligned with our $115.50 base case (+5.5%). Street views remain polarized between RBC Capital's $162 Buy and Citigroup's $90 Sell, reflecting divergent expectations on Kenvue integration execution and 2027 EPS dilution. Note: JPMorgan's Nov 17, 2026 resumption ($113 Neutral) is excluded as it occurred after the Nov 13, 2026 reference close.
